articles.title: A crayfish contest leads to a science puzzle
articles.summary: A friendly crayfish contest helped scientists learn that North American crayfish seem to have a size limit.

articles.title: Big and small black holes follow the same rule
articles.summary: Scientists found that black holes of all sizes seem to follow the same rule when they shoot out jets.

articles.title: Ancient pollen tells the story of ice age footprints
articles.summary: Tiny pollen grains show the people who made ancient New Mexico footprints lived through fast changes.
